error.title: Something went wrong
error.id_number_detected.message: The text seems to include an ID number. We discarded it without reading further.
error.id_number_detected.hint: Crop again so only the name, date of birth and gender are visible. Leave out the Aadhaar number, photo and QR code.

error.daily_cap_reached.hint: Type the fields from your document instead. Typed checks work as normal.
error.throttled.hint: Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.extractor_failed.hint: Try once more, or type the fields instead.
error.invalid_request.message: Some details could not be accepted.

error.not_found.message: The service could not be found.

error.internal_error.message: Something went wrong on our side.

consent.body: Your photo never leaves your phone. Only the text read from it is sent. It is processed on AWS in Sydney, Australia, and not stored.
nav.label: Sections
hero.body: Your Aadhaar, PAN, marksheet and bank passbook were filled in by different people, years apart. A strict system sees five different people.
hero.slipsLabel: The same name as printed on five documents, with differences marked
costs.title: You find out when it is too late.
costs.epf.title: A rejected PF claim
costs.epf.body: EPF claims are commonly rejected when the name, date of birth, Aadhaar or bank details do not match.
costs.aadhaar.title: Limited chances to fix Aadhaar
costs.aadhaar.body: You can change your name on Aadhaar only twice in a lifetime, and your date of birth or gender only once.
costs.link.title: PAN–Aadhaar linking
costs.link.body: Linking may fail when the name, date of birth or gender differ between the two.
how.title: Three steps. Two minutes.
how.step1.title: Add your documents
how.step1.body: Type the details, try a sample, or crop a photo. The photo is read on your phone.
how.step2.title: Confirm what we read
how.step2.body: You check every field before anything is compared.
how.step3.title: Get a fix plan
how.step3.body: See what differs, how risky it is, and which document to fix first.
how.privacyBody: Your photo never leaves your phone. Only the text read from it, and the details you type or confirm, are sent. They are processed on AWS in Sydney, Australia, and not stored. Long numbers such as your Aadhaar number are removed before anything is sent.
